RENTAL AGREEMENT

This Rental Agreement ("Agreement") is made on this 1st day of April 2026, by and between:
LANDLORD: Mr. Ramesh Sharma, residing at Indiranagar, Bengaluru.
TENANT: Mr. Ankit Kumar, residing at Bengaluru.

1. PREMISES & TERM
The Landlord agrees to rent Flat 302, Green Acres Apartment, Indiranagar, Bengaluru to the Tenant for a period of 11 months starting 1st April 2026.

2. RENT AND SECURITY DEPOSIT
The Monthly rent shall be Rs. 25,000 payable on or before the 5th of each month. The Tenant shall pay an interest-free Security Deposit of Rs. 1,50,000. The Security Deposit shall be returned to the Tenant after vacant possession is handed over, but no specific refund deadline or timeframe is specified for such return.

3. LOCK-IN PERIOD AND EARLY TERMINATION PENALTY
There shall be a mandatory lock-in period of 6 months. If the Tenant vacates the premises prior to the completion of the 6-month lock-in period, the entire Security Deposit of Rs. 1,50,000 shall be forfeited as an early termination penalty, and Tenant shall additionally pay 2 months rent.

4. INDEMNITY
The Tenant agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Landlord from and against any and all claims, liabilities, damages, losses, or expenses arising from the Tenant's use of the premises.

5. ARBITRATION & DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Any dispute or difference arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by binding arbitration in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The seat of arbitration shall be Bengaluru.
